source.title: Distributed control circuits across a brain-and-cord connectome
source.citation: Bates AS, Phelps JS, Kim M, Yang HH, et al. Nature. 2026.
source.dataLicense: CC BY 4.0 for the official Harvard Dataverse deposit, as stated by the source repository

biologicalScope.anatomicalCoverage: brain, suboesophageal zone, cervical connective, and entire ventral nerve cord

snapshot.dateDiscrepancy: The primary article dates final-print v888 to 17 April 2026; the per-file metadata documentation labels its v888 snapshot 16 April 2026. Preserve the discrepancy; v888 is the stable release key.
snapshot.metadataRowUnit: one row per segment; not an interneuron denominator

neuronMeshes.objectCountReason: The source map identifies the product location but the exact candidate object and per-object receipt have not been inspected in this project.

mitochondria.listedAnnotationSemantics: per-mitochondrion CAVE annotation table with v888 root IDs

projectAdmission.nextAdmissionGate: Select one exact v888 VNC-local interneuron from pinned metadata, then verify its stable root/segment identity, per-object mesh and internal-segmentation keys, coordinate frame, proofreading state, bytes and hashes, and object-level reuse terms before importing geometry.

hardBoundaries: BANC is one adult female fly connectome and remains a comparative invertebrate lane; it does not supply mouse spinal-cord anatomy or a vertebrate homolog claim.
The 188,162 metadata rows are segment rows, not an interneuron roster or denominator.
Dataset-level availability of cell, nucleus and mitochondrion products does not establish an exact same-cell object chain for a selected VNC interneuron.

The official source map both lists a v888 per-mitochondrion annotation table and marks a separate detected-mitochondria product as MISSING; this conflict remains visible until the exact product is resolved.
The application currently admits zero BANC objects and renders zero BANC geometry; no independent cell products are fused into a synthetic cell.
The primary paper reports incomplete synaptic-link attachment: only 18% of detected synapses have identified cells on both sides; connectivity is not function or causal transmission.

No project re-hosting occurs under this contract. The Dataverse deposit is stated as CC BY 4.0 by the official repository; any BossDB segmentation object still requires its exact object, bytes, provenance and reuse terms to be verified.
